limitations: Original authored diagnostic, not manufacturer factory image or full SDK/application compatibility.
Per-SKU catalog board/memory and public inputs are exercised independently; shared board reuse does not establish unsupported peripheral identity.
SPI display and A/B/C GPIO only. M5GO/FIRE RGB, IMU, microphone, audio, power, RF, TF transport and physical hardware are not accepted by these probes.
Classic images execute from SRAM after loading by original mask ROM as a diagnostic bootloader, without ROM stubs or appDirect.
